title: Café Reel With Matching Captions
tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

judge.summary: The visible reel frames have clear, correctly paired captions, but the pastry segment and its caption are not shown in the supplied samples.

must_haves.item: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
must_haves.why: The output is vertical and reported as 10 seconds; the four sampled photos follow the requested relative order, but no sample shows the pastry segment, which could fall between samples.

must_haves.item: Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
must_haves.why: Four captions are exact and correctly paired. 'Something sweet' is not visible in the provided samples; this does not establish its absence from the full clip.

must_haves.item: Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
must_haves.why: All sampled captions are comfortably within the frame and easy to read, but still frames cannot establish their display durations.

must_haves.item: Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
must_haves.why: The four visible captions use large white text on dark translucent panels with strong legibility; the pastry caption cannot be assessed.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.
must_haves.why: The sound report confirms audio but does not distinguish music from ambience or establish a mellow mood.
